_note: The charge baseline, per phase of one duty cycle, in microcoulombs. EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER AND NONE IS A MEASUREMENT. Nothing in this repository has run on hardware, so there is no measured baseline to commit. These exist so the gate itself can be written and proven on synthetic input; the first real run replaces them, and that replacement is the commit that makes this gate mean something.
_instrument: nRF PPK2, ampere-meter mode, with GPIO markers on its digital inputs dividing the cycle into phases. P10 is the project that establishes the phases; P07 establishes the cycle.
_tolerance: Five percent, from the chapter. A phase exceeding its baseline by more than that turns the build red.
